prompt: Which snippet correctly serializes an object 'dog' to a file?
choices: try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream("dog.dat"))) { oos.writeObject(dog); }
explanation: ObjectOutputStream.writeObject() serializes the object graph to binary format. Wrapping in try-with-resources ensures the stream is closed (and the object header flushed) even if an exception occurs. Option A writes a String representation, not binary serialization.
